form.label: CoolaShaker - Executive Overview
form.description: High-level operational metrics across all systems

search.query: index=demo_mes production_rate_per_hour=* | search location=$loc_tok$ | fields location production_rate_per_hour oee_pct defect_rate_pct machine_status
index=demo_infra | search location=$loc_tok$ | fields sensor_id location sensor_type value_celsius value_kw utilization_pct status
index=demo_mssql event_type=performance | search location=$loc_tok$ | eval db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | fields location db_host cpu_pct buffer_cache_hit_ratio deadlocks_per_sec

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics AND (metric_name=vmware.vm.cpu.usage.pct OR metric_name=vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct) BY location metric_name span=5m | search location=$loc_tok$

index=demo_thousendeyes | rename thousandeyes.agent.location AS location | search location=$loc_tok$ | fields thousandeyes.test.type location thousandeyes.test.name metric_name:http.server.request.availability metric_name:web.page_load.duration metric_name:web.page_load.completion metric_name:api.duration metric_name:api.completion server.address

index=demo_tomcat_logs | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "atlanta", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "berlin", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "vienna", 1=1, "unknown") | search location=$loc_tok$ | fields location host status bytes clientip useragent

html.p: Real-time monitoring across Vienna, Berlin, and Atlanta facilities and the DC Frankfurt

search.query: | stats avg(oee_pct) as avg_oee | eval avg_oee=round(avg_oee, 1) | eval range=case( avg_oee >= 85, "low", avg_oee >= 70, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_oee low=85-100 elevated=70-85 severe=0-70
| stats avg(production_rate_per_hour) as avg_rate | eval avg_rate=round(avg_rate, 0)

| stats avg(defect_rate_pct) as avg_defect | eval avg_defect=round(avg_defect, 2) | eval range=case( avg_defect <= 2, "low", avg_defect <= 5, "guarded", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_defect low=0-2 guarded=2-5 severe=5-100

| stats dc(eval(machine_status="running")) as running, dc(eval(machine_status!="running")) as not_running | eval total=running+not_running | eval pct=round(100*running/total, 0) | eval display=running." / ".total | fields display pct | eval range=case( pct >= 90, "low", pct >= 70, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=pct low=90-100 elevated=70-90 severe=0-70

| search sensor_type=temperature | stats avg(value_celsius) as avg_temp | eval avg_temp=round(avg_temp, 1) | eval range=case( avg_temp <= 22, "low", avg_temp <= 25, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_temp low=0-22 elevated=22-25 severe=25-50
| search sensor_type=power sensor_id=*-power-total | stats sum(value_kw) as total_power | eval total_power=round(total_power, 0)

| stats avg(buffer_cache_hit_ratio) as avg_cache | eval avg_cache=round(avg_cache, 1) | eval range=case( avg_cache >= 95, "low", avg_cache >= 90, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_cache low=95-100 elevated=90-95 severe=0-90

| stats avg(value) as avg_cpu | eval avg_cpu=round(avg_cpu, 1) | eval range=case( avg_cpu <= 70, "low", avg_cpu <= 85, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_cpu low=0-70 elevated=70-85 severe=85-100

| search thousandeyes.test.type=http-server | stats avg(metric_name:http.server.request.availability) as avail | eval avail=round(avail, 1) | eval range=case(avail >= 99, "low", avail >= 95, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avail low=99-100 elevated=95-99 severe=0-95
| search thousandeyes.test.type=page-load | stats avg(metric_name:web.page_load.duration) as plt | eval plt=round(plt * 1000, 0)

| search thousandeyes.test.type=api | stats avg(metric_name:api.completion) as completion | eval completion=round(completion, 1) | eval range=case(completion >= 99, "low", completion >= 90, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=completion low=99-100 elevated=90-99 severe=0-90

index=demo_tomcat_logs | eval location=case(host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02","atlanta",host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02","berlin",host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02","vienna",1=1,"unknown") | search location=$loc_tok$ | stats count as total, count(eval(tonumber(status)>=400)) as errors | eval error_rate=round(if(total>0, 100.0*errors/total, 0), 1) | eval range=case(error_rate<=10,"low",error_rate<=15,"elevated",1=1,"severe") | rangemap field=error_rate low=0-1 elevated=1-5 severe=5-100 | table error_rate

index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" | rex field=Location "(?i)(?<location>vienna|berlin|atlanta)" | eval location=lower(location) | search location=$loc_tok$ | stats avg(HealthScore) as health | eval health=round(health, 1)

index=demo_cisco_meraki sourcetype="meraki:wirelessdevicespacketlossbydevice" | rex field=network.name "(?i)^(?<location>vienna|berlin|atlanta)" | eval location=lower(location) | search location=$loc_tok$ | stats avg(downstream.lossPercentage) as loss | eval loss=round(loss, 1)

index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent | rename thousandeyes.agent.location AS location | search location=$loc_tok$ | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as loss | eval loss=round(loss, 2)

index=demo_msteams event_type IN (call_ended, call_failed) | search location=$loc_tok$ | stats count(eval(event_type="call_ended")) as ok count as total | eval success=if(total > 0, round(100 * ok / total, 1), 100) | fields success
index=demo_thousendeyes "thousandeyes.test.name"="AI Support Assistant API" | stats avg(metric_name:api.duration) as duration | eval duration=round(duration, 1)

index=demo_ai_defense sourcetype="cisco:ai:defense" | stats count(eval(event_message_type="prompt" AND event_action="Allow")) as prompts count(eval(event_message_type="response")) as responses | eval unanswered=if(prompts > 0, round(100 * (prompts - responses) / prompts, 1), 0) | fields unanswered
| mstats avg(_value) as ttft WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name="vmware.vm.gpu.llm.ttft.ms" location="frankfurt" | eval ttft=round(ttft, 0)
index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline" | stats max(calls_waiting) as waiting

index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:idoc:status" target_location=$loc_tok$ | stats sum(idocs_created) as created sum(idocs_delivered) as delivered | eval delivered_pct=if(created > 0, min(100, round(100 * delivered / created, 1)), 100) | fields delivered_pct
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:idoc" direction=outbound status="02" target_location=$loc_tok$ | stats count
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:mii:performance" location=$loc_tok$ | stats latest(mii_order_buffer) as buffer by location | stats min(buffer) as buffer
index=demo_sap sourcetype="sap:erp:performance" dialog_response_time_ms=* | stats avg(dialog_response_time_ms) as response | eval response=round(response, 0)

| union [| search index=demo_mes event_type=alarm severity=critical OR severity=error | eval source="Manufacturing", event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | table event_time location line_id source alarm_description severity | rename alarm_description as description] [| search index=demo_mssql event_type=alert severity=critical | eval source="Database", event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S"), db_host=mvindex(host, 0) | table event_time location db_host source message severity | rename message as description, db_host as line_id] [| search index=demo_windows_events EventType=Error | eval source="Windows", event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S"), severity="error", host=mvindex(host, 0) | table event_time location host source Message severity | rename Message as description, host as line_id] [| search index=demo_msteams severity=high | eval source="Teams", event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | table event_time location user_name source error_message severity | rename error_message as description, user_name as line_id] [| search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=api | where 'metric_name:api.completion' < 50 | eval source="API Monitor", event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S"), severity="critical" | eval description="[!] API degraded: ".'thousandeyes.test.name'." completion=".'metric_name:api.completion'."%" | eval location='thousandeyes.agent.location', line_id='server.address' | table event_time location line_id source description severity] [| search index=demo_tomcat_logs status>=400 | eval is_dos=if(match(useragent, "masscan|Go-http-client|libwww-perl"), 1, 0) | where is_dos=1 | eval location=case(host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02","atlanta",host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02","berlin",host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02","vienna",1=1,"unknown") | eval source="Webserver", event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S"), severity="critical" | eval description="[DOS] Scanner ".clientip." -> ".host."
